title: Multi-Sensor Navigation Simulation
dek: Interactive browser laboratories for GNSS, UAV dynamics, sensor fusion, atmospheric delay, and navigation algorithms.
body: UAVLab and NavLab are open-source, browser-based engineering environments for exploring navigation concepts with synthetic data.
The projects compare weighted least squares, 3D mapping-aided GNSS, and factor graph optimization while modelling satellite geometry, sensor measurements, urban masking, and atmospheric delay.
